pull_requests.title: Fix the internal energy used by the under-relaxation factor
Fix the HLLC scheme on moving grids and its Jacobians
Fix L2Roe, LMRoe and the general-gas Roe scheme in 3D
Fix the incompressible moving-grid Jacobian and several smaller mean-flow bugs
Use the SST k consistently in the compressible flow solver (fixes #1851)
Align the SST model with the NASA TMR definitions
Fix the second-order convection of turbulence and species
Fix the divergence of the SA wall functions
Fixes for the slope limiters of the flow
Fixes for rotational periodic boundaries: implicit solver, multigrid and limiters
Add a fully coupled periodic implicit operator
Multigrid linear prolongation with tigher full multigrid turbulence integration
Full Multi-Grid improvements
Multigrid with 3D implicit line agglomeration
Add nested preconditioner: FGMRES with BiCGSTAB
Fixing relaxation factor for conserved turbulent variables in SST model
Correct inconsistency regarding the density used in conservative scalar solver
Updating the Cross-Diffusion Term Discretisation in k-w SST Model
Modernize scalar numerics
Fix LINELET with mpi, add regression case for laminar NACA0012

scalar.body:
### Test cases

Files (configurations, histories, plot script) for each case: [scalarMuscl](https://github.com/rois1995/SU2/tree/pr-images/scalarMuscl). Meshes are from the TestCases repository. 2 MPI ranks, "develop" = `a6b7496b74`.

![MUSCL fixes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rois1995/SU2/pr-images/scalarMuscl/muscl_fixes.png)

**1. Values outside the allowed range:** `rans/naca0012/turb_NACA0012_sst.cfg`, 10°, from the free stream, `MUSCL_TURB= YES`.

| | iterations | CD |
|---|---|---|
| develop, first order | 447 | 0.015775 |
| develop, MUSCL | 10000, not converged | 0.4717 |
| this PR, MUSCL | 527 | 0.015743 |

**2. Bounded scheme with density ≠ 1:** `incomp_rans/rough_flatplate/rough_flatplate_incomp.cfg` without roughness, `BOUNDED_SCALAR`, water density (998.2) with the viscosity scaled to keep the Reynolds number. It must match the run with density 1.

| | converges | CD |
|---|---|---|
| develop, density 1 | yes | 0.0028593 |
| develop, density 998.2 | no, stalls | 0.0030075 |
| this PR, density 998.2 | yes | 0.0028593 |

**3. Limiter lost after `LIMITER_ITER`:** `rans/naca0012/turb_NACA0012_sa.cfg`, restart, turbulence limiter `VENKATAKRISHNAN_WANG`, `LIMITER_ITER= 50`.

| | CL |
|---|---|
| develop, no limiter | 1.0832985 |
| develop, limiter never frozen | 1.0824923 |
| develop, `LIMITER_ITER= 50` | 1.0832986, the same as no limiter |
| this PR, `LIMITER_ITER= 50` | 1.0824915, the same as never frozen |

**4. `VAN_ALBADA_EDGE` for turbulence:** `rans/flatplate/turb_SST_flatplate.cfg`, `MUSCL_TURB= YES`. Develop stops with "Unknown limiter type"; this PR converges (CD 0.0028093).

**5. Flow `VAN_ALBADA_EDGE` on the turbulence velocity:** case 3 with `SLOPE_LIMITER_FLOW= VAN_ALBADA_EDGE`. CL 1.0876936 on develop, 1.0878103 with this PR.

**6. Sliding interfaces:** `sliding_interface/bars_SST_2D` with `BOUNDED_SCALAR` and `KIND_INTERPOLATION= WEIGHTED_AVERAGE`. With this PR the bounded scheme follows `SCALAR_UPWIND`: rms[Rho] in zone 1 after 500 iterations is -4.399, against -4.397 for upwind and -4.207 before.

**7. Reconstruction gradient without MUSCL:** case 4 with first-order turbulence and `NUM_METHOD_GRAD_RECON= LEAST_SQUARES`, 1 rank. The histories are identical; 0.238 s per iteration instead of 0.296 s.

**New regression test** `turb_naca0012_sst_muscl_edge`: develop stops with "Unknown limiter type". The test values change if fix 3 or fix 5 is undone.

limiters.body:
### Test cases

Files (configurations, histories, limiter statistics) for each case: [limiters](https://github.com/rois1995/SU2/tree/pr-images/limiters). Meshes are from the TestCases repository. 2 MPI ranks, "develop" = `6db10127d1`.

**1. `NISHIKAWA_R4`:** new test `ramp_r4` (`euler/ramp/inv_ramp_r4.cfg`, the `ramp` case with `NISHIKAWA_R4`, 10 iterations from the restart).

| | rms[Rho] | CL | CD |
|---|---|---|---|
| develop | -2.179615 | -0.076739 | 0.054872 |
| this PR | -2.786698 | -0.076172 | 0.054828 |

The new unit test `[Limiters]` checks that a limiter gives the same value for an overshoot and for the same undershoot. Develop fails 13 of 50 checks.

**2. `WALL_DISTANCE` without a turbulence model:** `navierstokes/flatplate/lam_flatplate.cfg` with `SLOPE_LIMITER_FLOW= WALL_DISTANCE` and `ADJ_SHARP_LIMITER_COEFF= 0.02`, 50 iterations.

| | points with limiter 0 | mean limiter |
|---|---|---|
| develop | 4225 of 4225 | 0 |
| this PR | 45 (the wall points) | 0.69 |

New test `flatplate_wall_limiter` (the same case, 20 iterations): rms[Rho] -5.719472 on develop, -5.373432 with this PR.

**3. Zero width:** `rans/flatplate/turb_SA_flatplate.cfg` with `SLOPE_LIMITER_FLOW= WALL_DISTANCE`, 20 iterations.

| | points with limiter 0 |
|---|---|
| develop, `VENKAT_LIMITER_COEFF= 0.05` | 113 of 13289 (the wall points) |
| develop, `VENKAT_LIMITER_COEFF= 0` | 13289 of 13289, the run ends normally |
| this PR, `VENKAT_LIMITER_COEFF= 0` | stops with a configuration error |

**4. NEMO limiter outputs:** `nonequilibrium/invwedge/invwedge_roe.cfg` (5 species, 2D) with the `LIMITER` volume output.

| develop field | what it holds | name in this PR |
|---|---|---|
| `LIMITER_MOMENTUM-X` | limiter of the O2 density | `LIMITER_DENSITY_1` |
| `LIMITER_MOMENTUM-Y` | limiter of the NO density | `LIMITER_DENSITY_2` |
| `LIMITER_ENERGY` | limiter of the N density | `LIMITER_DENSITY_3` |

The new unit test `[NEMO][Output]` checks the names. Develop fails 25 of 26 checks.
